title: Pinterest Developers | MCP Server
snippet:
Meet the Pinterest MCP
## The common language of AI and APIs
Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open standard that enables AI assistants to connect directly with external services. The Pinterest MCP Server brings Pinterest data into the AI tools you already use, giving agents native access to rich inspiration and creative signals — without custom code or fragile integrations. It helps teams move from idea to on-brand creative direction with Pinterest intelligence available right where they work.
Built for Pinterest workflows
Bring Pinterest Ads capabilities into the AI tools your team already uses. Query, analyze, and act through a consistent interface powered by the existing Pinterest API.
Open-standard integration
Built on MCP, with compatibility across tools such as Claude, Cursor, and VS Code.
Secure, scoped access
OAuth 2.0 authorization and granular permissions keep credentials protected and access appropriately controlled.
Less integration work
Skip custom API wrappers. The MCP server manages authentication, rate limits, and response formatting, so teams can move faster.
How it works
## Bring Pinterest intelligence into your AI workflow
Set up the Pinterest MCP Server once in your preferred AI environment. From there, you can search Pins, explore and manage Boards, uncover emerging trends, and access audience insights — all through natural-language prompts without leaving your chat or editor.
Find the performance stories hidden in your data.
Turn insights into action — create, update, and optimize with confidence.
Catch the next big idea before it takes off, using trends.
Turn audience and keyword signals into your next smart move.
```
{
"pinterest-mcp": {
"type": "http",
"url": "https://api.pinterest.com/mcp",
"headers": {
"Authorization": "Bearer <token>"
}
}
}
```

title: Pinterest keyword data in ChatGPT and Claude (MCP) · PinPinterest
snippet:
## 1. Get your API key
Create an account, then open **Settings → API** in the dashboard and press Create key. The same key works for the [REST API](/developers) and here, and both draw on one monthly allowance.
Server URL: `https://api.pinpinterest.com/mcp`
## 2. Add it to your app
### Claude Code
Run this once in your terminal, then ask Claude Code a Pinterest question.
```
claude mcp add --transport http pinpinterest https://api.pinpinterest.com/mcp \
--header "Authorization: Bearer pp_live_YOUR_KEY_HERE"
```
### Claude.ai & Claude Desktop
Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector.
Name it PinPinterest and paste this URL (with your key in place of the placeholder). Leave the OAuth fields empty.
```
https://api.pinpinterest.com/mcp?key=pp_live_YOUR_KEY_HERE
```
### ChatGPT (developer mode)
Settings → Apps & Connectors → Advanced settings → turn on Developer mode.
Create a connector, paste this URL (with your key), and choose "No authentication" — the key in the URL is the authentication.
```
https://api.pinpinterest.com/mcp?key=pp_live_YOUR_KEY_HERE
```
### Cursor
Add this to the file, then reload Cursor.
File: `~/.cursor/mcp.json`
```
{
"mcpServers": {
"pinpinterest": {
"url": "https://api.pinpinterest.com/mcp",
"headers": {
"Authorization": "Bearer pp_live_YOUR_KEY_HERE"
}
}
}
}
```
### VS Code (Copilot agent mode)
Add this to the file in your workspace, then start the server from the file.
File: `.vscode/mcp.json`
```
{
"servers": {
"pinpinterest": {
"type": "http",
"url": "https://api.pinpinterest.com/mcp",
"headers": {
"Authorization": "Bearer pp_live_YOUR_KEY_HERE"
}
}
}
}
```
### n8n
Add an MCP Client Tool node to your AI Agent and fill in these three fields.
```
Endpoint: https://api.pinpinterest.com/mcp
Server Transport: HTTP Streamable
Authentication: Bearer Auth → pp_live_YOUR_KEY_HERE
```
Replace `pp_live_YOUR_KEY_HERE` with your key. Keep a URL with your key in it private — anyone holding it can spend your lookups. You can revoke a key and make a new one at any time.
